title: Peaks in Array II
summary: Maintain nums under point replacements. A peak subarray has length at least three and contains an interior element strictly larger than both neighbors. For query [1,l,r], count subarrays wholly inside inclusive range [l,r] that contain at least one such peak; count a subarray once even if it has several peaks. Query [2,index,val] replaces one array element. Return answers to type-1 queries in order.
officialConstraints: 3 <= n <= 100000; values and replacement values are 0..100000.
1..100000 queries; 0 <= l < r < n; replacement indices are valid.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
